name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd
title: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd-$ - 522163 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR690cr (+129% YoY) and EBITDA margin 12.3%, with management guiding FY27 revenue INR4,300-4,500cr and six-line CCV/MV capacity build; QIP-funded ramp is unproven versus a 34% cable utilisation base.

utilisation.quote: We entered the year running the plant well below its capacity, with several lines only partially loaded

capex.quote: we are in the final stages of ordering our sixth CCV line, and this is purely based on the demand which we are seeing

triggers.label: Sixth CCV line ordered, ~INR100cr
triggers.quote: we are in the final stages of ordering our sixth CCV line

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR4,300-4,500cr
triggers.quote: we are firmly on track to deliver a full year top line in the range of INR4,300 crores to INR4,500 crores

triggers.label: Working capital need up 20-30%
triggers.quote: You need to suddenly have 20%, 30% more of incremental working capital.

triggers.label: Order book INR3,688cr, ~2x FY26 revenue
triggers.quote: As on August 11, 2026, it stood at INR3,688 crores, roughly $445 million, and about 2 times of last year’s revenue

guidance.quote: we are firmly on track to deliver a full year top line in the range of INR4,300 crores to INR4,500 crores
Our guidance is between 11% to 13%. This again depends upon the metal price.
we will grow from INR1,900 crores to INR4,500 crores and the year next to INR7,500 crores
we are expecting that our data center sales will contribute around INR750 crores before the month of March
we have targeted that we will get an order book of at least INR500 crores before we end the year

red_flags.label: Net worth negative INR922cr pre-QIP
red_flags.quote: as on 30th June '26, our net worth is negative by INR922 crores

red_flags.label: Q1 revenue flat QoQ, guidance needs ~2x run-rate
red_flags.quote: the balance sheet of the year needs to run at close to twice the pace of the first quarter

red_flags.label: Adani concentration ~40%+
red_flags.quote: The present order book from Adani is around 40% plus.

red_flags.label: Legacy receivables INR957cr, ~INR300cr expected recovery
red_flags.quote: there are INR957 crores of legacy receivables on the books

evasions.quote: We are open in terms of how we can ramp up and scale up. We are always on the lookout..
for export, it is too early for me to put a number, because we have to test the waters properly.

evasions.topic: Adani share and net worth turn-positive timing
evasions.quote: We are a growing company. The market is growing.
